theorem Roth.one_mem_RSet.{u_1} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {B : ℝ}, 1 ≤ B → ∀ (r : σ → ℕ), 1 ∈ Roth.RSet B r :=
fun {σ} {B} hB r ↦
  of_eq_true
    (Eq.trans
      (congr (congrArg And (Eq.trans (congrArg Not one_ne_zero._simp_1) not_false_eq_true))
        (Eq.trans
          (congr
            (congrArg And
              (Eq.trans
                (forall_congr fun j ↦ Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg LE.le (degreeOf_one j)) (r j)) zero_le._simp_1)
                (implies_true σ)))
            (Eq.trans
              (forall_congr fun d ↦
                Eq.trans
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congrFun'
                      (congrArg LE.le
                        (Eq.trans
                          (Eq.trans
                            (congrArg abs
                              (Eq.trans (Eq.trans (congrArg Int.cast (coeff_one d)) (apply_ite Int.cast (0 = d) 1 0))
                                (ite_congr (Eq.refl (0 = d)) (fun a ↦ Int.cast_one) fun a ↦ Int.cast_zero)))
                            (apply_ite abs (0 = d) 1 0))
                          (ite_congr (Eq.refl (0 = d)) (fun a ↦ abs_one) fun a ↦ abs_zero)))
                      B)
                    (congrFun (apply_ite LE.le (0 = d) 1 0) B))
                  (Eq.trans (ite_apply (0 = d) (LE.le 1) (LE.le 0) B)
                    (Eq.trans
                      (ite_congr (Eq.refl (0 = d)) (fun a ↦ eq_true hB) fun a ↦ eq_true (LE.le.trans zero_le_one hB))
                      (ite_self True))))
              (implies_true (σ →₀ ℕ))))
          (and_self True)))
      (and_self True))
